definition.name: ProcessClaim
definition.description: Processes and adjudicates insurance claim using Go implementation. Validates eligibility, checks benefit coverage, applies plan rules (copay/coinsurance/deductible), and determines approval status. Returns approved amount, processing time, and rejection reason if denied. Executes real-time claim adjudication workflow. Algorithmically equivalent to TypeScript and Python implementations.

fields.name: approved
fields.description: Boolean indicating whether claim was approved for payment. True means all validation, eligibility, and benefit checks passed successfully.

fields.name: approvedAmount
fields.description: Dollar amount approved for payment after applying copay, coinsurance, deductible, and benefit limits. Null if claim was rejected.

fields.name: claimId
fields.description: Unique claim identifier linking result back to submitted claim. Used for tracking, reporting, and member communication (EOB generation).

fields.name: processingTime
fields.description: Time in milliseconds to adjudicate the claim. Used for performance monitoring and SLA compliance tracking across different processing engines.

fields.name: rejectionReason
fields.description: Human-readable explanation if claim was denied (e.g., 'not eligible', 'benefit exhausted', 'out of network'). Null if approved.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Processing outcome status (APPROVED, DENIED, PENDING). Determines next workflow steps - payment processing, appeal handling, or additional review.
